rationale: Selected open_tie_13 and shed_bus3_15 to remove the 18 MW overload on l12 while minimizing load shedding to 15 MW. This combination brings l12 to 96 MW (within 100 MW limit), l23 to 78 MW (within 90 MW limit), and keeps l13 at 65 MW (within 80 MW limit). All constraints are satisfied with 2 actions and minimal shedding.
